Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

shh! interjection

also sh, shush, hush, psst, hist

classical

Plaut. Cas. 148: St! tacē atque abī.
Plaut. Ps. 952b: St, tacē, aedēs hīscunt.

St!

shh! hush!

(vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

Lewis & Short: “hist! whist! hush!”. Mostly followed by tacē or tacēte; it also serves as the whispered “psst!” before a secret: Dīcis? st! invēnī nūper quandam. (Ter. Haut. 597).

Other words

  • Tacē! Tacēte! — be quiet!

    imperative of <span lang="la">taceō</span>, singular and plural · also used · classical · Plaut. Curc. 156: st tacē, tacē.

    See be quiet.

Examples

  • St! tacē atque abī.

    Shh! Quiet, and off you go.Plaut. Cas. 148

  • St, tacē, aedēs hīscunt.

    Shh, quiet, the door’s opening.Plaut. Ps. 952b

  • St, tacē, auscultā modo.

    Shh, quiet, just listen.Plaut. Most. 489b

  • St, tacēte, habēte animum bonum.

    Shh, quiet, cheer up, both of you.Plaut. Epid. 181

See also be quiet, put a finger to one’s lips, stop talking, lower your voice.
